6971.title: Thread storage deletion removes installed plugin sources
6971.rootCauseOneLine: Path installations retain their original thread-storage directory, which cleanup deletes without preserving or relocating the installed plugin source.

prReviews.verdict: STATIC ONLY — relevant approach, not runtime verified
prReviews.topFinding: A caught relocation failure can let deletion continue while the registration still references the old source; verify failure behavior.

6971.proposedFix: Preserve source in durable plugin-owned storage before deletion and relocate through the existing path-registration flow, retaining settings. No duplicate PR: open PR #6973 already links this issue.
6971.caveats: Service-level reproduction twice, not a live CLI or retention sweep. Both production builds passed; all 39 existing service tests passed. Linked PR code was not run.
